name: io.github.nirholas/vid2context
title: vid2context
description: Turn any video into context for AI agents: transcripts, metadata, chapters, timestamps.

environmentVariables.name: GROQ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Groq free tier: fast Whisper speech-to-text and LLMs

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Google AI Studio free tier LLMs

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. OpenAI, used last and only when set

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Local Ollama server, for example http://localhost:11434/v1

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_STT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Local OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text server, for example http://localhost:8000/v1
